hero.description: Type what you see in plain language — a red vintage car on a coastal road, a woman in a yellow dress reading — and ImageFlow surfaces it from across the web.

steps.title: Describe
steps.body: Write what you see in plain English. No keywords, no tags — just a natural sentence.

steps.title: Search
steps.body: Our multimodal model converts your words into a visual embedding and scans 2.4B images in under 140ms.

steps.title: Find
steps.body: Ranked results surface the closest visual matches with source attribution and licensing info.

features.title:
Built for creators
and developers
features.body: ImageFlow speaks both languages. A clean UI for designers and photographers, a powerful REST API for engineers building visual search into their products.

list.label: Natural language queries
list.desc: No boolean operators or tags — just describe what you see.

list.label: REST & GraphQL API
list.desc: Full programmatic access with SDKs for JS, Python and Go.

list.label: Reverse image search
list.desc: Upload an image and find visually similar results instantly.

list.label: Batch processing
list.desc: Run thousands of queries asynchronously via webhooks.
